sources.massKg: typical 2-pax + fuel operating mass, research doc range 950-1050 kg. NOT max gross (1157 kg): the POH V-speeds are quoted at max gross, but hitting them at max gross would require a CLmax outside the sourced 1.47-1.58 range. Documented compromise, decisions.md B-006.
sources.wingAreaM2: JSBSim c172x.xml, cross-checked Roskam (174 sq ft)
sources.clAlphaPerRad: NACA 2412 2D slope with finite-AR correction; JSBSim table range 4.5-4.7
sources.stallAlphaRad: 15.0 deg — NACA 2412 critical AoA. Implies CLmax_clean = 0.25 + 4.9*0.2618 = 1.533, inside the sourced 1.47-1.58 range.
sources.postStallDecayRad: TUNING KNOB — 0.20 rad (11.5 deg) fade width from CLmax toward flat-plate lift past the break. Gives the soft mushy stall the 172 is known for (about 15% CL lost in the first 2 deg past the break); smaller is a sharper CL cliff. Does NOT move CLmax.
sources.cd0: TUNING KNOB — raised from the JSBSim book value 0.032 to 0.035 so that 75% power at 8000 ft settles at ~123 kt TAS, inside the POH 122-124 kt band. Real CD0 is unpublished.
sources.oswaldE: TUNING KNOB — 0.70, derived from a published C172 model (CD0=0.0329, K=0.0599).
sources.cyBeta: textbook light-single side-force slope; makes a slip cost energy
sources.rollRateMaxRadS: 40 deg/s — middle of the research doc's 30-45 deg/s light-GA estimate
sources.pitchRateMaxRadS: 20 deg/s — TUNING KNOB, no published figure
sources.yawRateMaxRadS: 15 deg/s — TUNING KNOB, no published figure
sources.damping/stiffness: TUNING KNOBS. Pitch: omega_n = sqrt(3.0) = 1.73 rad/s, zeta = 2.5/(2*1.73) = 0.72 — a well-damped short period.
sources.refDynamicPressurePa: TUNING KNOB — 1200 Pa (~44 m/s at sea level). Controls scale with q/qref, clamped to 1, so authority fades toward the stall.
sources.trimAlphaCenterRad: 1.0 deg — near the cruise AoA so trim = 0 is roughly hands-off cruise
sources.propPeakSpeedMs: TUNING KNOB — 60 m/s (117 kt). Below it, prop efficiency falls linearly, which both caps static thrust at eta*P/60 = 1790 N (402 lbf) and brings sea-level climb from an absurd 1570 fpm down to ~740 fpm vs the POH's 730 fpm.
sources.flaps: 172S has 0/10/20/30 detents. dCL0/dStallAlpha tuned so flaps-30 CLmax = 1.0 + 4.9*0.2094 = 2.03, putting Vs0 at ~41.8 kt against the POH's 40 KIAS. dCD0 values are TUNING KNOBS.
sources.gear: fixed — the 172 has no retractable gear; the HUD reads FIXED and G is inert
